lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno heard let sleeping dogs lie,
He tiptoed past the puppies, shy!
Kiki whispered, cute, but see,
It's not just puppies, listen to me!
[chorus]
Let sleeping dogs lie, let sleeping dogs lie,
If the trouble's quiet, let it pass on by!
Let sleeping dogs lie, let sleeping dogs lie,
Don't stir it up, don't even try!
[verse]
It means a problem settled down
Is best left quiet, don't come around,
Don't poke it, prod it, bring it back,
Keep the peace and stay on track!
[chorus]
Let sleeping dogs lie, let sleeping dogs lie,
If the trouble's quiet, let it pass on by!
Let sleeping dogs lie, let sleeping dogs lie,
Leave it be and wave goodbye!
[outro]
So if old trouble's fast asleep,
Let it lie and don't make a peep!
